programs.note: A single bounded CI status probe; ci-watch repeats it until the run reaches a terminal state.

Polls the latest CI run inside a bounded repeat cell and returns only the terminal status. The sleep+gh-poll loop — and every intermediate status dump — stays inside the runtime, out of the model's context.
Bounded diff in, structured verdict out. The model reviews a byte-capped slice (never the raw repo) and must answer inside a declared schema — exactly one agent call.
Byte-bounded diff read: stat plus a clipped patch, never an unbounded git diff dump in context.
One bounded tool call replaces the status/diff/log round-trip set: repo state arrives pre-digested, so raw git output never enters the model's context.

Generic fitness probe for malleable habitats: spawns the candidate manifest against one labeled case and reports {ok, expect, got}. A failed or skipped spawn contributes nothing — the outer scorer counts delivered verdicts only.

Runs up to four declared gate commands (test/lint/typecheck/build) inside one bounded tool call and returns the stage verdicts plus failure tails only — the agent stops babysitting sequential check commands.
One bounded tool call produces the repo map — top-level dirs, manifests, key source files, README head — replacing the ls/find/cat round-trips an agent would otherwise spend context on.

Malleable habitat: an agent proposes ONE candidate router manifest as data, the each-cell population evaluates it against labeled cases through hab-eval-inner, and a pure scorer emits the fitness record. The host promotes winners into the router:champion slot — evolution never mutates the running organism.
Routes through the champion manifest in the router-champion slot — the durable endpoint of router-habitat promotion. An empty slot serves the packaged default router via the slot's declared default.
One classifier call maps a task description to the algal-skills lane that should handle it. This manifest is the malleable genotype: router-habitat evolves prompt and label set against labeled cases.
Bounded ripgrep inside a tool call: the agent gets the top-N match lines, never a raw grep dump to page through.
Runs the declared test command inside a bounded tool call and emits only the verdict, extracted failure lines, and a tail — the full log never reaches the model's context.
Bounded page fetch: HTML stripped to text, clipped to a byte cap, with source byte count — the model sees the extract, not the raw page.
